title: fix(service-storage): the pending-upload retention keeps a pending sys_file a record or attachment still holds
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XSxRKLpZsRFYJdB6iumoyqn)_
Fixes #26533
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`sys_file` 的「未完成上传 7 天清理」现在先问「还有谁持有这个文件」(与墓碑分支同一个判定 `findFileHolder`:`sys_attachment` 行或 `ref_*` 列)。被记录或附件持有的 pending 文件不删字节、不删行、保持 `pending`,每次清理打一条 warn 点名文件和持有者;无人持有的照旧清理。
- **为什么改**:main 上实测:一条被记录占着的 pending 文件过 7 天后,字节和 `sys_file` 行都被清掉,记录字段仍指向该 id(数据丢失)。#26531 之前用户写入能造出这种行;今天系统写入(种子加载器先写记录、后 `claimFiles`)仍会造出。
- **风险与回滚**:只会少删,不会多删;判定读失败时保留到下一轮。被保留的文件不会被标成 `committed`(那会跳过 `/upload/complete` 的字节核对)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/services/service-storage/src/attachment-lifecycle.ts` 的 `createSysFileReapGuard` pending 分支;`src/pending-claimed-file-reap.integration.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage exec vitest run src/pending-claimed-file-reap.integration.test.ts`,预期 1/1 通过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `createSysFileReapGuard` (`attachment-lifecycle.ts`), the `pending` branch: before the byte delete it asks `findFileHolder(engine, id, row)`, the same hold question the `deleted` branch asks (a `sys_attachment` join row, or the `ref_*` ownership columns via `hasFieldReferenceOwner`). It is one read per candidate row, only over the rows the sweep already handed the guard.
  - Held: veto (the row is not confirmed), no byte delete, no write to the row. It stays `pending`: the guard does not commit it, because committing would skip the byte check `/upload/complete` makes. One `warn` per sweep names the file, its holder (`the record OBJECT/ID.FIELD`, or an attachment) and the two ways out: the uploader completes the upload, or the record lets go of the file and the next sweep reclaims it.
  - Unheld: best-effort byte delete, then confirm, as before.
  - The hold read throwing: caught by the existing `catch`, so the row is vetoed and retried next sweep (fail toward retention). That warn now says "reclaim failed" instead of "byte delete failed", since either step can be the cause.
- A private `describeHolder` helper for the warning text. Nothing exported changes.
- Patch changeset for `@objectstack/service-storage`.

## Tests

- New `src/pending-claimed-file-reap.integration.test.ts`: a real `ObjectQL` over sqlite `:memory:`, `StorageServicePlugin` on the local adapter registering its own reap guard with a real `LifecycleService` whose clock stands 8 days ahead. Two presigned uploads are PUT and never completed. A system insert makes `media/m_1.poster` hold one of them (`pending` with `ref_*` stamped, the state a signed-in write left before #26531). After `lifecycle.sweep()`: the held file keeps its bytes (`storage.exists`) and its row (`pending`, `ref_*` intact), the record still names it, and exactly one warning names it and `media/m_1.poster`. The unheld file of the same age is reaped, row and bytes.
- `src/attachment-lifecycle.test.ts`: the held veto on each surface (`ref_*` columns, a `sys_attachment` row): no delete, no update, one warning naming the file; and a hold read that throws vetoes.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured on `origin/main` `ab3c776a`, before the fix** (a scratch copy of the new test printing the state after the sweep, then deleted): `{"errors":[],"claimedBytes":false,"claimedRow":null,"recordPoster":true,"abandonedBytes":false,"abandonedRow":null}`. So the card's premise holds, and it is worse than its text: the sweep deletes the held file's `sys_file` row as well as its bytes, while the record keeps the id.
- **Can a held pending row still be created on `main` after #26531?** Not by a signed-in user write: that is refused. By a system or context-less write, yes: the field-reference hooks stamp `ref_*` and leave the row `pending`. #26531's own test `a system write is not judged: the seed loader writes over a pending row it commits after` pins exactly that state, and the new integration test builds its fixture the same way. In the seed loader the window is short (it calls `claimFiles` right after the record write), but a process that dies between the two leaves the state for good. So the guard covers existing rows and this remaining producer.
- The warning repeats each sweep until the file is completed or released. That is the "flagged for an operator" the triage allows; no new state, column or gate.
- Not in scope, noted: the download door still answers `404` for a held pending file (#26531 measured it). Completing the upload is the remedy the warning names.

## Verification

- Ablation at `cca42daf` (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `if (holder) {` in the pending branch x1 → x0, replaced by `if (false && holder) {`, blob `9392fabf` → `47e2926a`): over the two suites, **3 failed, 48 passed (51)**, exactly the three held-veto cases (the integration test and both `it.each` rows). The hold-read-throws case stays green, as expected: the throw still reaches the `catch`. Restored by the script: blob after restore `9392fabf` = the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty.
